title: Deity category front matter
description: A canonical worship-category entity (data-model.md's 'Deity'). Temple.deities is deliberately free-text (temple-specific local epithets), so these files define the coarser categories used to compute a 'temples by deity worshipped' grouping (data-model.md's 'Curated Collection', FR-011) rather than being hand-maintained lists — see scripts/validate_content.py --deity-report.

match_keywords.description: Case-insensitive, word-boundary-matched substrings used to bucket a Temple into this category by scanning its `deities` array. Not part of the original data-model.md field list; a pragmatic addition so the grouping can be computed rather than hand-maintained. Keep specific (e.g. 'narasimha', 'narsimha') to avoid false matches against unrelated compound epithets.
